visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair, wearing a light blue button-down shirt, stands in a studio setting designed like a bar. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a refrigerated display case filled with colorful Japanese wagashi. There are rows of mochi in shades of pink, yellow, white, and green, some shaped like flowers. (3) The man reappears, gesturing with his hands as he speaks energetically. Brightly colored text overlays appear on the screen to emphasize his points. (4) Footage transitions to an aerial shot of a red torii gate standing on a small island in a serene lake surrounded by hills and trees. (5) A map of Europe is briefly shown, followed by another aerial shot of a lush green river valley in Taiwan with a slow-moving river winding through the mountains. (6) Historical black-and-white photos of a man in a formal suit (Goto Shimpei) and a 5000 yen Japanese banknote (Nitobe Inazo) appear to illustrate the history of the sugar industry. (7) A final shot of the man pointing at the camera concludes the sequence in the same bar studio.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 臺灣吧. [Slogan]: 最有畫面感的臺灣史. [Subtitle]: 聽說 日本甜點 這麼有名. (2) [Subtitle]: 跟臺灣有關係喔？ (3) [Subtitle]: 喔～沒錯. (4) [Subtitle]: 每次去日本. (5) [Subtitle]: 尤其是在各個百貨公司的地下一樓. (6) [Subtitle]: 整片的甜點區. (7) [Subtitle]: 驚為天人. (8) [Subtitle]: 這其實跟臺灣 糖 的輸入是有關係. (9) [Subtitle]: 怎麼說？ (10) [Subtitle]: 明治維新以後. (11) [Subtitle]: 日本就要富國強兵. (12) [Subtitle]: 就認為吃糖可能是一個關鍵要素. (13) [Subtitle]: 當然啦 吃糖不見得真的可以讓人長得比較高大. (14) [Subtitle]: 但是它一定是一個文明化的重要象徵. (15) [Subtitle]: 所以他們就開始想辦法找糖. (16) [Subtitle]: 但是日本自己沒有生產很多. (17) [Subtitle]: 他們的緯度其實跟歐洲差不多. (18) [Subtitle]: 歐洲其實是靠種甜菜. (19) [Subtitle]: 所以他們想說也來種甜菜 結果失敗了. (20) [Subtitle]: 剛好 1895 年 日本獲得了臺灣. (21) [Subtitle]: 而這個臺灣啊 可是從荷蘭時期就開始在種蔗糖了. (22) [Subtitle]: 那後面故事 動畫臺灣史 就有講過嘛. (23) [Logo]: 民政長官 後藤新平. [Subtitle]: 後藤新平來到臺灣以後呢. (24) [Subtitle]: 要發展臺灣的糖產業. (25) [Subtitle]: 就邀請了 新渡戶稻造. (26) [Subtitle]: 來改革臺灣糖業. (27) [Subtitle]: 他就寫課本上面都會收錄的 臺灣糖業改良意見書. (28) [Subtitle]: 開始大量的新建新式精糖廠. (29) [Subtitle]: 就有源源不絕的糖送往日本. (30) [Subtitle]: 讓日本甜點產業 就有非常充足的原料來源. (31) [Subtitle]: 日本人感覺都可以一直吃甜點耶. (32) [Subtitle]: 但是你知道嗎？去統計其實日本每人平均的糖分攝取 甚至低於臺灣. (33) [Subtitle]: 也就是他們雖然有這麼豐富的點心文化 但是吃的沒那麼勤. (34) [Subtitle]: 臺灣吃的還比較多. (35) [Variety]: 留言「甜點」. [Subtitle]: 留言「甜點」就告訴你更多相關資訊喔.
